Subject: Trailwool Socks are back in stock
Preview: Three pairs of merino wool blend socks, ready when your next trip is.
Body: Your next stretch of trail deserves socks that hold up to it.

The Northbay Trailwool Sock (NB-SOK-11) is back in stock. Each pack includes three pairs, all made from a merino wool blend — which means temperature regulation on variable days, and less odor buildup on multi-day trips compared to synthetic-only options.

A few honest notes: these are built for hiking and everyday trail use, not for extreme mountaineering or technical crampon work. Merino blends wear well, but they're not indestructible — sharp rocks and heavy abrasion will shorten their life like any sock.

Three pairs per pack. Merino wool blend. Back in stock now.
